Seorang kanak-kanak perempuan autistik maut dalam kejadian di sebuah pangsapuri di Ladang Tok Pelam, Kuala Terengganu, pagi Sabtu.

Dalam kejadian kira-kira jam 7 pagi itu, mangsa ditemui di kawasan tempat letak kenderaan di tingkat enam pangsapuri berkenaan.

Difahamkan, mangsa bersama keluarganya dari Pasir Puteh, Kelantan, berada di negeri ini untuk bercuti dan menginap di sebuah inap desa di tingkat 13 premis berkenaan sejak Jumaat.

Who has always dreamed of studying in Oxford, Cambridge, or Edinburgh? 🇬🇧

The UK Future Leader Program 2027 is now officially open for applications! This is a one week international learning program for students, young professionals, and emerging leaders aged 18 to 45, who want more than just a trip abroad. You will study English alongside international students, stay with a local host family, and explore Oxford, Cambridge, or Edinburgh, three of the most iconic learning cities in the world.

It is a real learning experience, built around communication, leadership, and personal growth, in an environment that genuinely pushes you forward.

Here is what you will get from the program:
✔️ Homestay accommodation with a local UK family (breakfast & dinner included)
✔️ English & communication classes with international students
✔️ College visits & city explorations
✔️ Public speaking & leadership sessions
✔️ Real intercultural experience & international network
✔️ Official certificate of participation
✔️ Travel insurance included

Choose your pathway:
📍 Oxford — 21 to 27 March 2027
📍 Cambridge — 4 to 10 April 2027
📍 Edinburgh — 18 to 24 April 2027

Sekurang-kurangnya enam individu disahkan maut selepas tentera Israel dan kumpulan peneroka haram Israel melancarkan operasi ke atas beberapa bandar dan perkampungan di Tebing Barat yang diduduki sejak malam tadi.

Menurut laporan Al Jazeera, insiden di perkampungan Sarra, barat Nablus mengorbankan empat warga Palestin dan dua warga Israel selepas pertempuran tercetus di kawasan berkenaan.

Susulan kejadian, tentera Israel dilapor memperketat kawalan keselamatan di beberapa kawasan selain melancarkan operasi ketenteraan di seluruh Tebing Barat.

Lebih ramai pemimpin Pakatan Harapan (PH) menggesa Laporan Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) berkaitan Tabung Haji didedahkan kepada umum dengan segera.

Terbaharu ialah Timbalan Presiden Parti Amanah Negara (Amanah), Datuk Seri Mujahid Yusof Rawa, yang mengeluarkan kenyataan bersama Naib Presiden PKR, Datuk Seri Amirudin Shari dan Naib Pengerusi DAP Johor, Senator Sheikh Umar Bagharib Ali, hari ini.
